title: Lantern custom shell decisions
summary: Reject selective reports, approve a first full report, and defer later requests using retained ChatML review state. Includes a separate model-review entry point.
required: Installed Ochat, /bin/sh and awk, a required Seatbelt or bubblewrap backend and configured gpt-6-astra provider. Create reports before startup; inspect and authorize the chosen entry point.

commands: Extract the generated archive, compare every maintained file, and run ochat shell inspect on agent.chatmd and model-agent.chatmd
Run sh scripts/check-docs.sh --check all --write-report from the extracted sample-project
verification.observed: Exact public sources execute through the required shell backend. The ChatML reviewer rejects selective reports, approves the first full report, and defers a later request to the user; denial preserves existing evidence. The model variant rejects selective reports before calling its reviewer. A stubbed nested-agent callback verifies the stock tool-free prompt, permits a real check, and then returns malformed output to prove denial without overwriting the report. Both extracted entry points resolve their declared dependencies; captured-source checks reject missing companions for every entry point that uses them.
verification.limitations: No live provider, physical TUI walkthrough of this bundle, or Linux execution. The model callback is stubbed: this verifies integration and failure behavior, not model judgment. The extracted checker also ran directly; confinement and reviewers are exercised separately by runtime integration tests.
